_meta.purpose: Soldier persona + concise/verbose axis.  Soldier is the second-role pick for concise/verbose per base_persona_candidates.txt (axis=non_goal; soldier from goal pool, |μ|=1.50, n=2) — a soldier persona naturally leans concise (terse military-comms style), giving the concise pole an aligned baseline and the verbose pole genuine headroom to push expansive responses.  Question selection is open-ended value-probes + sharp role-edge dilemmas where the response length is meaningful (i.e. the verbose pole produces a long substantive answer; the concise pole produces a short punchy one).

design_notes: Per AGENT_NOTES guideline #11 (length-collapse pathology on concise/verbose), plan to filter records by len_ratio >= 0.4 at analysis time -- this protects against trivial one-line refusals or canned short responses at extreme concise steering.

The soldier persona is naturally concise-leaning, so expect strong dose-response on +1 (toward verbose) and modest response on -1 (toward concise, where the baseline is already terse).  This is the inverse of the typical first-role configuration where the persona aligns with the virtuous/RLHF pole; soldier was picked as second-role precisely so the un-RLHF-preferred concise pole has aligned baseline.
